name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with and continues the given context, ensuring it is pertinent to the preceding conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to maintain interest and encourage further dialogue, keeping the conversation flowing naturally.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical consistency and clarity of the response within the context of the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not coherent and 5 is completely coherent.

name: Depth of Knowledge
description: Determines the level of insight or information provided in the response, reflecting understanding or expertise on the topic.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is superficial and 5 is very insightful.

name: Empathy
description: Measures the extent to which the response shows understanding of and sensitivity to the emotions or viewpoints of the other conversation participant(s).
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 shows no empathy and 5 shows high empathy.
